heading: Meet the Team
intro: The people who help bring the magic to Sane Living Center, from the first walk-through to the last song.

members.name: Karol Avalon
members.bio:
With more than four decades in hospitality and events, Karol is one of the steady pulses of Sane Living Center’s heartbeat. As Director of Special Events, she guides each gathering from the first walk-through to the final farewell, bringing calm organization, warm hospitality and an eye for the details that make an event feel effortless.

Her career has spanned producing inspirational conferences and retreats, creating and leading multi-day events at sea, supporting sales and marketing for boutique Sonoma County inns, and serving as Vice President of Merchandising for the Red Rose Collection. Today she also consults with Life Journeys Global production company and oversees property management, and she brings every bit of that experience to each host who walks through the purple doors.
